title: Ocr and reports is not implemented
body: `ViolationPipeline(system_config, detector, ocr, helmet_detector, seatbelt_detector, store, alerts)`: constructed by keyword; `process_frame(frame, frame_context) -> list[ViolationRecord]` returns every violation emitted on that frame. Each `(track_id, violation_type)` combination must fire at most once per pipeline instance. The helmet rule only applies to two-wheelers (`motorcycle`/`motorbike`/`scooter` labels); the seatbelt rule only applies to `car` labels. The returned list is ordered deterministically by ascending `track_id`, breaking ties by a fixed `ViolationType` precedence equal to the declaration order of the enum — `RED_LIGHT`, `WRONG_WAY`, `OVER_SPEED`, `LANE_CHANGE`, `NO_HELMET`, `NO_SEATBELT`, `RECKLESS_DRIVING` (so `RECKLESS_DRIVING` always sorts last among a track's violations).
acceptance_hint: 6 executable checks over the ocr_and_reports surface.
